hints.title: Serpentine Column Path Traversal
hints.text: Elements must be arranged into a two-dimensional grid by filling columns sequentially, alternating between downward and upward movement.

hints.title: Dimension Validation and Parity Reversal
hints.text: If row count multiplied by column count does not equal array length, return an empty array. Even columns traverse downward; odd columns traverse upward.

hints.title: Matrix Population Blueprint
hints.text: Allocate matrix of size rowsCount x colsCount. Loop col from 0 to colsCount - 1: if col % 2 === 0, iterate row from 0 to rowsCount - 1; else iterate row from rowsCount - 1 down to 0. Populate from array and return matrix.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct linear pass placing each item into preallocated matrix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded matrix operations or irregular resizing incur repeated reallocation overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating the exact output grid dimension avoids dynamic row expansions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Strict dimension check (rowsCount * colsCount === this.length) returning empty array upon mismatch.
